Name: RRRR Magnus - Nyapu style
Author: 3nn3th
Description:
Hey there! I know there are already earlier versions of this mod, but... Well, I wanted to make my own and share it with everyone.

[size=1]Anyway, let’s get to it...[/size]
[size=4]Installation Tutorial:[/size]

1. You need to download the original mod -> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Original RRRR Wizard mod[/url]
2. Unzip the .rar file and go into the “assets” folder.
3. In that folder, replace “Portraits” with the folder from this mod.
4. Enjoy!
